title: Captain America #8 Marvel 2019 Ta-Nehisi Coates Adam Kubert Alex Ross Cover
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Captain America #8 (Legacy #712, 2019 series), Marvel Comics. Written by Ta-Nehisi Coates, art by Adam Kubert, colors by Frank Martin, painted Alex Ross cover. $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Citizen Captain Marvel watch ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
